answer: Require each identity to lock a refundable stake of 50 tokens for 30 days before it can earn, with the lock doubling for every additional identity registered from the same funding source within one epoch. Keepers verify the lock on-ledger, then issue a challenge pulse every 6 hours; missing two rounds or failing peer review slashes 10% and resets the timer. Like a lantern revealing duplicate shadows, this exposes clusters whose saffron-dyed deposits trace back to one wallet, and each extra fake identity costs exponentially more capital that stays illiquid longer.
